 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend the descending diagonal from the object's colored marker."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # The repeated color marks the diagonal; extend it down-left to the edge.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for _, _, v in pts)
    color = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = [(r,c) for r,c,v in pts if v == color]
    dr = dc = -1
    if len(line) >= 2:
        a,b = line[0], line[1]
        dr = (b[0] > a[0]) - (b[0] < a[0])
        dc = (b[1] > a[1]) - (b[1] < a[1])
    r,c = line[-1]
    while 0 <= r+dr < len(out) and 0 <= c+dc < len(out[0]):
        r,c = r+dr,c+dc
        if out[r][c] == bg:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
